bio.text: Rebecca Bextel is the Constitution Party candidate for Governor of Wyoming in 2026.
Bextel's WyoFile election guide response says the candidate was born in Alabama and has lived in Wyoming for more than 20 years.
The response describes Bextel as a small business owner who raised four daughters in Wyoming.
